title: Interneurons and network activity in the cerebral cortex: a developmental dialogue
title_zh: 皮层抑制性神经元与网络活动的对话：发育视角
abstract: The mammalian cerebral cortex undergoes profound functional changes during early postnatal development. During this period, neurons generate spontaneous electrical activity long before sensory experience, coordinating into distinct patterns of synchronous activity. Traditionally, neuronal activity has been viewed as instructing interneuron development by modulating transcriptional programmes, morphology and connectivity. However, accumulating evidence in rodents reveals that this relationship is bidirectional: cortical interneurons are not merely passive recipients of activity-dependent signals but also active architects of developing network dynamics. They regulate spontaneous activity transitions from gap-junction-mediated synchronous events to large, synaptically driven bursts, and later to sparse firing characteristic of mature circuits. Critically, different interneuron subtypes mature at distinct timelines and orchestrate transitions in network activity. Activity-dependent mechanisms, in turn, regulate interneuron wiring, programmed cell death, diversification and terminal differentiation. This reciprocal dialogue between interneurons and network activity is essential for establishing functional cortical circuits. Neuronal activity is traditionally viewed as instructing cortical interneuron development. In this Review, Moissidis and Marín discuss how interneurons also actively shape early postnatal network activity, establishing a reciprocal dialogue that drives the maturation of both interneurons and cortical circuits.
abstract_zh: 哺乳动物大脑皮层在早期产后发育期间经历深刻的功能变化。在此期间，神经元在感官经验之前产生自发电活动，并协调成不同的同步活动模式。传统上，神经元活动被视为通过调节转录程序、形态和连接性来指导抑制性神经元的发育。然而，啮齿类动物研究积累的证据表明，这种关系是双向的：皮层抑制性神经元不仅仅是活动依赖信号的被动接收者，而且是发育中网络动力学的主动架构师。它们调节自发活动从Gap连接介导的同步事件向大型突触驱动爆发，以及随后向成熟电路特征的稀疏放电的转变。不同的抑制性神经元亚型在不同的时间线上成熟，并协调网络活动的转变。依赖活动的机制反过来调节抑制性神经元的连接、程序性细胞死亡、分化和终末分化。抑制性神经元与网络活动之间这种相互对话对于建立功能性皮层电路至关重要。传统上，人们认为神经元活动指导皮层抑制性神经元的发育。在本综述中，Moissidis和Marín讨论了抑制性神经元如何主动塑造早期产后网络活动，建立一种相互对话，驱动抑制性神经元和皮层电路的成熟。
